description: The public record on ONE company, by the `entity_id` find_company returned (or a Swiss UID): identity, dated register changes, sanctions-list checks and the sections the summary lists. Without `layer` the answer is a summary of at most 6,000 characters; with `layer` (register, history, sanctions, identity, leadership, regulator, or another section the summary lists) one section, paged with `cursor`. `as_of` (YYYY-MM-DD) gives the file as it stood on a date; `since` (YYYY-MM-DD) lists the changes after a date, and by default the summary shows what changed since this account last opened the file. A thin file (an entity_id starting 'lei:', a company with no Swiss UID) has no history: its GLEIF record, its parents and the Swiss companies it owns, and sanctions-list checks.
name: company_file
title: Company file
